test.visual: from section 3 on, some displays are up to 0.06px taller in the browser, which measures some text MathJax only estimates in Node

examples/complex.why: tex4ht doesn't convert the pictures in its side-by-side code boxes (tcolorbox listings), and MathJax can't parse the macros that split comma-separated arguments (\cvc, \rvc, \mat, \Sum and its relatives)
allow: left undefined for MathJax, which can't read their definitions: \cvc
examples/complex.visual: from its first numbered display on, formulas are up to 0.02px taller in the browser, which measures some text MathJax only estimates in Node; across the page the screens shift by a few pixels; and with MathML for screen readers (TEX8WEB_MATHML, which the tests set), the hidden MathML of a formula broken across lines is as wide as the formula on one line, which can make the page wider than a phone's screen
